parameters.query:
SELECT id, severity::text AS severity, alert_key, title, detail, created_at
  FROM campaign.alerts
 WHERE resolved_at IS NULL
   AND notified_at IS NULL
 ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'warning' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, created_at
 LIMIT 20

nodes.name: Unnotified alerts
nodes.notes: Read-only. Uses the campaign_readonly role, which is granted SELECT on alerts and UPDATE only on alerts.notified_at.
